pullRequests.title: feat(revolverator): list Revolverator 0.3.3
pullRequests.author: noire342
pullRequests.head: feat/list-revolverator
pullRequests.body:
Adds the external Revolverator listing from noire342/openrac-mods/revolverator.
The weapon uses the native inventory, ammunition HUD and save flow. Version 0.3.3 adds drill-contact sparks while holding a spinning enemy, automatic local asset preparation, and support for mod interface 1.12 or compatible later minor interfaces. PAL Europe v2.00 is the native reference; NTSC-U keeps its separate binding profile.
